manaNeeded: {1}{B/P} the first turn, with {1}{B/P} available the second turn if you do not control a Smaug token
notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control a Smaug token, or you control five additional artifacts.
description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it, triggering its third chapter ability.
Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing a lore counter from There and Back Again, and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the There and Back Again ability, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token.
If you control two Smaugs, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If a Smaug dies this way, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
